title: His mother's singing, relatives, and Celestin's band at school closing
summary: His mother sang in the church choir but stopped; no relatives played music; Celestin's band played at school closings where he first saw Henry Zeno, and he and Snags Jones held whistling contests.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Excuse me for interrupting you again, but about your home and all, did your mother ever sing? Or did anyone? I'm sorry. Well yes, my mother. You don't have to keep those in, it'll pick up anything.

Yeah, my mother was very nice songstress in the church choir, that's where I was told that. But she stopped singing when I was somewhere around two or three years old. She had trouble with her throat.
You probably remember hearing her sing earlier when you were a baby.
Yeah, but I'd be here singing at home, but my mother had a nice voice.
And so- Any other relatives play any music?

I don't remember any relatives of mine that ever played any music. And as I know of, I had an uncle supposed to graduate this conservatory in Boston, a great uncle but I never did see him, my mother told him about it but I never did see it. And Celestan, the great Celestan, that was coming to him every year in June when school closed, they'd hire Celestan's band to play for us. That's when I first saw Henry Zeno. And Celestan, and Johnny Dodson, fellas like that. So we would get around those fellas and the next day we'd have a whistling contest between me and Snagg Jones and Ovid Farnett and the fellas like that. So when I went back to New Orleans later on with Lil Armstrong they wasn't surprised that I was playing music because Snagg used to get the rounds of the chairs and we'd play, get them high box steps like they had in New Orleans and we'd whistle and have to do it, sometimes trills. And of course Snagg he started playing drums before me. He played with this fellow, this fiddle player in New Orleans, not Robichaud. He played with the show.
